description: NaNO₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded to one N and six O atoms to form distorted NaNO₆ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃N tetrahedra and edges with six equivalent NaNO₆ pentagonal bipyramids. The Na-N bond length is 2.52 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.57 Å. N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two O atoms. Both N-O bond lengths are 1.26 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and one N atom to form distorted ONa₃N tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaNO₆ pentagonal bipyramid, corners with two equivalent ONa₃N tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₃N tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one N atom.
